decision: An optional member prefix and an expression, with no terminating semicolon, exactly as SysML 8.2.2.19 writes it — including the `?` on MemberPrefix.
notes:
THIS IS THE SYSML VARIANT (ADR-0014). The other language states this production differently and is a separate unit, derived from its own clause and not consulted here.

THE `?` IS KEPT because this unit follows its own clause as written. It is redundant: MemberPrefix is itself `VisibilityIndicator?` and already derives the empty string, so `MemberPrefix?` accepts the same text as `MemberPrefix`. Before ADR-0014 this production was one shared unit that dropped the `?` on that argument; with a SysML variant of its own there is no reason to depart from the SysML clause. The redundancy makes the rule ambiguous for a general parser (the empty prefix has two derivations) without changing what it accepts. SysML.xtext drops the `?`.
